name: boba-bops
description: Boba Bops POS: run npm scripts from here to work on both the API and the React app.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,lt -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run dev:lt"
scripts.dev:lt: ${LT_BIN:-libretranslate} --load-only en,es,fr,de || echo 'LibreTranslate not found, translation disabled'
